COMMUNITY
NOVARA community

Voluntary links to the public project. No feature is gated by stars, forks or follows.

No GitHub action is automated. Stars, forks, watches and issues are always performed by the user on GitHub. The public website is prepared locally and has not been published.

Recognition follows useful work, not engagement metrics

Accepted bug reports, merged code, documentation, translations, accessibility work, reproducible QA reports and useful integration adapters are eligible for human review. Benefits are subject to published criteria and an approved budget. A star is not a qualifying contribution and never unlocks a feature.
